# SequenceDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSequenceDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasSequenceDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasSequenceDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasSequenceDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

UML: classes, or a sequence

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasSequenceDiagram](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSequenceDiagram.md)
- [UltraCanvasPacketDiagramProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasPacketDiagramProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
SequenceDiagramStyle CreateForTheme(SequenceDiagramTheme theme);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSequenceDiagram> CreateSequenceDiagramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSequenceDiagram> CreateSequenceDiagramWithModel( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, const UltraCanvasSequenceModel& model);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSequenceDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onMessageClick` | `std::function<void(size_t, const SequenceMessage&)> onMessageClick` | _Message click_ |
| `onLifelineClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onLifelineClick` | _Lifeline click_ |
| `onFragmentClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onFragmentClick` | _Fragment click_ |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void()> onSelectionChanged` | _Selection changed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `SequenceDiagramTheme`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Default` | neutral blue-grey heads on white — the house look |
| `Classic` | reference image 1: golden head boxes, hairline arrows |
| `Professional` | reference image 2: teal heads and activation bars |
| `Colorful` | reference image 3: a different accent per lifeline |
| `Minimal` | no fills, hairline borders |
| `Dark` |  |

### enum `SequenceNumbering`

What number, if any, is written before each message label.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Hidden` |  |
| `Sequential` | 1, 2, 3, ... |
| `Hierarchical` | 1, 1.1, 1.1.1, 1.2 — follows the call nesting |
